# genavatar.me

> Deterministic avatar API. Turn any username, email, UUID, Unicode string, or emoji into a square PNG. The same ID always returns the same face.

## API

- Base URL: https://api.genavatar.me
- Named avatar: `GET https://api.genavatar.me/{id}`
- Random avatar: `GET https://api.genavatar.me/`
- Size: `?size=16` to `?size=400`, default `400`
- Analytics opt out: `?notrack=true`
- Response: `image/png`
- CORS: `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`
- Headers: `X-Genavatar-Id`, `X-Genavatar-Size`, `X-Cache-Status`

## Documentation

- API documentation: https://genavatar.me/docs/
- Integration examples: https://genavatar.me/guides/
- OpenAPI: https://genavatar.me/openapi.json
- Gravatar alternative: https://genavatar.me/gravatar-alternative/
- Random avatar API: https://genavatar.me/random-avatar/
- Default avatar URL: https://genavatar.me/default-avatar/
